name: self_v2
note: self_v1's five sentences, unchanged so the two variants stay comparable, plus the three answers the base variant never used: satisfaction with EU membership (the survey's Q18), with NATO membership (Q17), and covid vaccination (Q23). The wording follows the survey's own questions - "s tím, že ... je členem" is how they are asked. A dataset lacking these columns renders exactly self_v1, and a non-substantive answer drops its own sentence. The satisfaction answers arrive already agreeing with the gender (resolved at cleaning); the vaccinated filter reads the row's gender for the verb.
